_comment: Seed fragments for KAN-31. The full trilingual library is KAN-32; ids are stable across languages so switching language translates a reading rather than changing the prediction. Tags come from HoroscopeSignals.

fragments.text: The Moon sits well for you today, and the day moves with less friction than it has lately.
The Moon is awkwardly placed, so expect the day to ask for more patience than usual.
Several placements agree with you at once, which is not common — use the room they give you.
This is a day to hold your ground rather than to start something new.
Saturn is still moving through the heavy stretch around your Moon; steadiness matters more than speed.
An ordinary day, and there is something to be said for one of those.
Nothing in the sky is pulling hard in either direction, so the day is largely yours to shape.
Small things attended to early will keep the afternoon clear.
Guru favours your work sector — a good day to ask for what you have earned.
Saturn rewards the unglamorous work today; finish what is half done.
Avoid making a large commitment at work this week if it can reasonably wait.
Steady progress at work, with nothing demanding a decision from you.
A colleague may need more from you than they say outright.
Shukra is kind to your finances today; a purchase you have delayed is reasonable now.
Keep spending small today and let the larger decision wait a few days.
Money matters stay quiet — a good day to look at what is going out rather than what is coming in.
Nothing pressing financially, though a small debt may be worth settling.
Venus is well placed, and warmth offered today is likely to be returned.
Kuja is restless; a sharp word will travel further than you intend.
An easy day with the people close to you, if you make the time for them.
Someone is waiting for you to speak first.
Rest is worth more than effort today; sleep early if the day allows it.
Old aches may speak up. Move gently rather than not at all.
Health holds steady; water and a short walk will carry you further than anything else.
Nothing troubling, though eating at regular hours will help more than usual.
Saturn asks for discipline rather than luck. Keep your promises small and keep them.
Begin the thing you have been circling.
Postpone what can be postponed, and be kind to yourself about the rest.
Do the difficult thing before noon.
Say less than you are tempted to say.
